main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move of long cases (return from signal close minus coin's normal 5-bar drift)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of unusual move on forecast at entry

decided_by: t between -2 and 2 over at least 30 cases: inconclusive.
reading: A case is the first long bet bar (forecast rise >= 2 from its low since the last bet) in each non-overlapping 5-bar grid cell of a window, its return taken from that bar's close over 5 bars within the window, minus the coin's mean grid 5-bar return over all its windows.
